name: dev.urldone/urldone
title: UrlDone
description: Headless URL check for coding agents. Compact JSON verdict before you say done.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Mint a UrlDone API key with 20 free checks. No human form. Optional owner_email and source (registry|glama|mcp.so|mcpservers.org|pulsemcp|smithery|npm|cli|llms.txt|referral|internal|registry-test|other). Unknown source becomes other; the raw string is stored for analysis. If source is omitted, the request URL query ?source= is used (e.g. https://urldone.dev/mcp?source=glama). source=internal is attribution only — it does not grant billing exemption. Rate-limited by IP. Returns api_key — store it and send Authorization: Bearer <api_key> on later calls.

source.description: How you found UrlDone (registry|glama|mcp.so|mcpservers.org|pulsemcp|smithery|npm|cli|llms.txt|referral|internal|registry-test|other). Unknown values are stored as other. If omitted, the MCP/REST URL ?source= query is used.

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Open a public http(s) URL in headless Chromium and return a compact JSON verdict (pass|fail). Use this before you tell a human you are done. Optional expectations (plain English), bypass_token for Vercel Deployment Protection, viewport, wait_for (selector, ms, or load|networkidle). Costs 1 credit (or 1 free check). Our crashes/timeouts are not charged. If credits are 0, the error includes top_up_url for the human owner.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Return credits_remaining, free_checks_remaining, and a Stripe Checkout top_up_url for this API key.
